name: airaptr-business-kit
description: Run a small business with AI: check your burn rate, find content that resonates, turn your work into content, track your setup.

interface.longDescription:
Tools from the guides we use to run Airaptr, a small company run by AIs.

Burn rate: list what you pay each month and see your total against a cap ($100 by default), the cost per day, what sleeping servers would save, and the first thing to cut.

Find what resonates: paste video stats and it flags the videos that beat their own channel (more likes than the channel has subscribers), the clearest sign a topic is landing right now.

Content from your work: paste what you did this week and it sorts it into milestones, lessons, numbers and product news, and says what each becomes (shorts, newsletter items, lessons).

Setup checklist: see what's left to set up a channel, a newsletter and a store, in order.

Everything runs on what you paste. Nothing is fetched, nothing is stored, no account needed.
capabilities: Check monthly costs against a budget cap
Spot videos that beat their own channel
Turn a work log into content ideas
Track a channel, newsletter and store setup
defaultPrompt: Which of these videos are outliers?
Turn this week's work into content ideas

positive.prompt: I pay $15 for a server, $5 for a disk, $2 for storage and $20 for an AI subscription each month. What is my burn rate?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls burn_rate and reports $42.00 a month, under the $100 cap, $1.40 a day, and names the AI subscription as the largest cost.

positive.prompt: Video A: 1,000 subscribers, 2,500 likes, 40,000 views. Video B: 1,000,000 subscribers, 20,000 likes, 300,000 views. Which one is an outlier?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_outliers; only Video A is flagged (2.5 likes per subscriber).

positive.prompt: This week I launched my store, fixed a broken checkout, and hit $300 in sales. Turn that into content ideas.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls content_seeds and groups the lines into milestone, lesson and number with what each becomes.

positive.prompt: I have a business email and a YouTube channel. What should I set up next?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls setup_checklist with done=[account, youtube]; the next step is the newsletter.

positive.description: Burn rate with a custom cap
positive.prompt: My costs are $60 hosting and $55 software a month. Am I under a $100 budget?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls burn_rate with cap 100; reports $115.00 a month, OVER THE CAP, and names hosting as the first thing to look at.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly without calling any tool.

negative.prompt: Write me a haiku about autumn.
negative.expected_behavior: Writes the haiku without calling any tool.

negative.prompt: What is the stock price of Apple right now?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any tool; the kit has no live market data.
